# Legacy tooling export adapter

This original adapter exports a callable wrapper around the unmodified, registry-pinned `minimatch@11.0.1` (installed with the `minimatch-modern` npm alias). It preserves the upstream `Minimatch`, `filter`, `match`, `defaults`, `braceExpand`, `sep` and `GLOBSTAR` helpers. Legacy ESLint consumers expect `require('minimatch')` to return a function, whereas newer consumers use named exports. Version 11 removed regex generation: the installed import plugin's `makeRe(...).test(path)` contract is implemented with a compiled patched matcher. Its result is a test object, not a RegExp; regex source/exec semantics are intentionally unsupported. Defaults retain that adapter contract.

The root tooling dependency and override provide the legacy export. Explicit scoped overrides for glob, Expo fingerprint and TypeScript-ESTree provide the normal upstream 11.0.1 module to modern consumers. No old matching code, patched source copy, install script or advisory suppression is included. npm still audits the actual upstream implementation as a registry dependency. This is a compatibility adapter for inspected consumers, not a promise of every minimatch 3 behavior; focused fixtures, a real import-rule enforcement test and the full lint/build checks cover our tooling usage. Remove it when the legacy consumers adopt the modern API. Review scopes whenever adding/upgrading consumers.

See [upstream source](https://github.com/isaacs/minimatch/blob/v11.0.1/src/index.ts) and [security advisory](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249).
